piece_type: DTC TV ad “KISQALI_mBC_OKE_Jordan 60 Second Major Statement Update_US_2.25”
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.cat: Misleading presentation of study data (exploratory endpoint)
cases.claim: SUPER: “Premenopausal women taking KISQALI with an NSAI and goserelin lived for 58.7 months vs 47.7 months on an NSAI and goserelin alone.” | VO: “. . .Then I learned about KISQALI. . .a pill that stops cancer from growing. . .and can help me live longer.”
cases.context: PI final OS (MONALEESA-7): median not reached vs 40.7 months, HR 0.699. SUPER uses 54-month extended exploratory, non-prespecified analysis.
cases.rationale: Exploratory OS medians without context/limitations or full KM curve are misleading.
cases.check: Rule: survival numbers in promo must match PI-reported final analysis; flag medians from extended/exploratory follow-up.

cases.cat: Distracting presentation of material efficacy qualifier (SUPER)
cases.claim: SUPER (frame 13): “Postmenopausal women taking KISQALI plus an NSAI lived for 63.9 months vs 51.4 months on an NSAI alone. Premenopausal women ...” — 40 words in ~6 seconds
cases.context: 400 wpm vs average 238 wpm; competing VO indication and music with lyrics.
cases.rationale: SUPER cannot be read/comprehended; undermines material efficacy information.
cases.check: Rule: compute SUPER words-per-minute; flag > ~238 wpm, and flag concurrent different-content VO/lyrics.
